html:
A soldier who led a rebellion from Darfur and took power in Chad in December 1990, overthrowing Hissene Habre, and ruled until he was killed in April 2021.

He allowed multiparty elections, which he always won. Oil exports began in 2003 through a pipeline to Cameroon's coast, but the money went mostly to the army and his circle. He survived rebel attacks on N'Djamena in 2006 and 2008 and became a main military ally of France against jihadists in Mali and against Boko Haram around Lake Chad. He was killed fighting rebels in the north, days after winning a sixth term, and his son Mahamat took power.
sum: A soldier who led a rebellion from Darfur and took power in Chad in December 1990, overthrowing Hissene Habre, and ruled until he was killed in April 2021.
